question.text: Long-term capital gain on listed equity shares (holding > 12 months, STT paid) for Cat III AIF is taxed at:

answer.text: 12.5% on amount in excess of Rs. 1.25 lakh (post-July 2024)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.3 Table 9.1, LTCG on listed equity with STT paid = 12.5% on amount exceeding Rs. 1.25 lakh per FY. The Trap: 10% was pre-July 2024; 20% is STCG rate; 30% is MMR. Cross-Exam Context: Post-Finance Act 2024 rates. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use the updated 12.5% LTCG rate in all post-July 2024 computations.
